description: Boundary contract for OpenBSD sealed-brick pass/fail/unknown decisions. No engine implementation referenced; Rheknel is CANDIDATE_UNVALIDATED.

output_enum.pass_definition: All invariants satisfied and required evidence meets minimum tier.
output_enum.fail_definition: At least one invariant explicitly violated with supporting evidence tier.
output_enum.unknown_definition: Required evidence missing, not meeting tier, or contradictory without resolution.
output_enum.error_definition: Evidence malformed, evaluator missing, or authority ceiling breached.
output_enum.escalate_definition: Unresolved disagreement or out-of-scope state requiring human escalation.

compatibility.notes: Rheknel not hard-coded. Host deterministic oracle validated in TRIBUNAL-RT-V0 as pass, tiny models as advisory.

notes: Boundaries per TRIBUNAL-RT-V0: host oracle succeeded, SmolLM2-135M advisory with critical false-PASS + prompt-injection failures. LLM output = advisory only.
